summary: A comprehensive system architecture audit of the TD Games AI Agent & Memory Database. Covers: system diagram, 5 key strengths (separation of concerns, agent persona system, data pipeline design, lazy init patterns, auto-provisioning), 13 issues ranked by severity (active_bots not populated, code duplication, SQLite thread-safety, missing LLM retry logic, prompt source duplication, missing rate limiting, digest state tracking, admin auth, health checks, auto-cleanup, team directory RAG integration, config hardcoding, missing tests), and a prioritized upgrade roadmap with effort estimates.
